narrative: Fed keeps rates at 3.75% as hawkish dissent and Warsh’s resolute inflation stance spark a bear steepener — USD/JPY retreats to 163.45 despite a 266bp OIS carry advantage; gold higher +0.62%; equities -1.52%; DXY -0.57%; VIX 20.7. Middle East escalation drives a 6.7% surge in WTI, supporting CAD and NOK as the dollar tumbles to a one-week low. Options markets show a strong -1.55 risk reversal skew in USD/JPY, signaling elevated downside hedging demand. Watch the next Bank of England meeting and the Bank of Japan meeting tomorrow.
